title: Structure a 15s Seedance prompt with explicit timecodes (e.g., 0:00–0:02…
content:
Structure a 15s Seedance prompt with explicit timecodes (e.g., 0:00–0:02, 0:02–0:04) to force a clear beat-by-beat sequence of actions.

Use an uploaded character sheet and state “strict visual reference” plus detailed wardrobe/props to keep character identity consistent across shots.

Specify audio behavior explicitly (track starts at frame one, never stops, constant underlying SFX, actions synced to beat) to lock timing and sound continuity.

Call out shot types per beat (wide/close/overhead) and require camera angle changes every 2–3 seconds to avoid static framing.

Add “we clearly see every step” and list the exact micro-actions (crack/spin/chop, launch/land) to improve action legibility and reduce ambiguous motion.

Define a consistent visual style stack (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain) and include negative style constraints (not cartoon/Disney/Pixar) to prevent unwanted stylization drift.

Reinforce persistent environmental continuity with repeated constraints (warm dramatic lighting, constant steam rising, sizzling sound constant) to keep atmosphere stable across the clip.

Include “chronological cooking order maintained throughout” to prevent the model from reordering steps or jumping ahead.

es.content:
Estructura un prompt de Seedance de 15 s con timecodes explícitos (por ejemplo, 0:00–0:02, 0:02–0:04) para forzar una secuencia clara de acciones beat by beat.

Usa una character sheet subida y especifica “strict visual reference” junto con vestuario/props detallados para mantener la identidad del personaje consistente entre planos.

Especifica el comportamiento del audio de forma explícita (la pista empieza en el frame uno, nunca se detiene, SFX de fondo constantes, acciones sincronizadas con el beat) para fijar el timing y la continuidad sonora.

Indica los tipos de plano por beat (wide/close/overhead) y exige cambios de ángulo de cámara cada 2–3 segundos para evitar un encuadre estático.

Añade “we clearly see every step” y enumera las microacciones exactas (crack/spin/chop, launch/land) para mejorar la legibilidad de la acción y reducir el movimiento ambiguo.

Define una pila de estilo visual coherente (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain) e incluye restricciones de estilo negativas (not cartoon/Disney/Pixar) para evitar desviaciones de estilización no deseadas.

Refuerza la continuidad ambiental persistente con restricciones repetidas (warm dramatic lighting, constant steam rising, sizzling sound constant) para mantener estable la atmósfera a lo largo del clip.

Incluye “chronological cooking order maintained throughout” para evitar que el modelo reordene los pasos o se adelante.

fr.content:
Structurez un prompt Seedance de 15 s avec des timecodes explicites (par ex. 0:00–0:02, 0:02–0:04) afin d’imposer une séquence d’actions claire, beat par beat.

Utilisez une character sheet importée et indiquez « strict visual reference » ainsi que des détails précis sur la tenue et les accessoires afin de conserver la cohérence de l’identité du personnage d’un plan à l’autre.

Spécifiez explicitement le comportement audio (la piste démarre à la première frame, ne s’arrête jamais, SFX de fond constants, actions synchronisées sur le beat) pour verrouiller le timing et la continuité sonore.

Précisez les types de plans pour chaque beat (wide/close/overhead) et exigez des changements d’angle de caméra toutes les 2 à 3 secondes afin d’éviter un cadrage statique.

Ajoutez « we clearly see every step » et listez les micro-actions exactes (crack/spin/chop, launch/land) pour améliorer la lisibilité de l’action et réduire les mouvements ambigus.

Définissez une pile de style visuel cohérente (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain) et incluez des contraintes de style négatives (not cartoon/Disney/Pixar) pour empêcher toute dérive de stylisation indésirable.

Renforcez la continuité environnementale persistante avec des contraintes répétées (warm dramatic lighting, constant steam rising, sizzling sound constant) afin de maintenir une atmosphère stable tout au long du clip.

Incluez « chronological cooking order maintained throughout » pour empêcher le modèle de réordonner les étapes ou d’anticiper.

ja.content:
---
15秒のSeedance promptを、明確なタイムコード（例: 0:00–0:02、0:02–0:04）付きで構成し、アクションをビートごとに明確に順序立てて強制する。

アップロードした character sheet を使用し、「strict visual reference」と、衣装・小道具の詳細を明記して、ショット間でキャラクターのアイデンティティが一貫するようにする。

音声の挙動を明示的に指定する（トラックはフレーム1で開始し、決して止まらない、常に下地のSFXが鳴り続ける、アクションはビートに同期する）ことで、タイミングと音の連続性を固定する。

各ビートごとに shot type（wide/close/overhead）を明記し、2〜3秒ごとに camera angle を変更するよう求めて、静的なフレーミングを避ける。

「we clearly see every step」を加え、正確な micro-actions（crack/spin/chop、launch/land）を列挙して、アクションの判読性を高め、曖昧な動きを減らす。

一貫した visual style stack（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime、semi-realistic CGI、hand-painted textures、Unreal Engine quality、film grain）を定義し、望ましくないスタイライズのずれを防ぐために negative style constraints（not cartoon/Disney/Pixar）も含める。

繰り返しの制約（warm dramatic lighting、constant steam rising、sizzling sound constant）によって持続的な環境の連続性を強化し、クリップ全体で雰囲気を安定させる。

「chronological cooking order maintained throughout」を含めて、モデルが手順を並べ替えたり先に飛ばしたりしないようにする。
---

ko.content:
---
15초짜리 Seedance prompt를 명시적인 타임코드(예: 0:00–0:02, 0:02–0:04)와 함께 구성해, 동작이 비트 단위로 명확하게 이어지도록 강제한다.

업로드한 character sheet를 사용하고, 캐릭터의 정체성을 샷 전반에 걸쳐 일관되게 유지하기 위해 “strict visual reference”와 함께 상세한 의상/소품을 명시한다.

오디오 동작을 명시적으로 지정한다(트랙은 프레임 1에서 시작하고 절대 멈추지 않으며, 지속적인 underlying SFX가 유지되고, 동작은 비트에 맞춰 동기화됨) כדי 타이밍과 사운드의 연속성을 고정한다.

비트마다 shot type(wide/close/overhead)을 명시하고, 정적인 구도를 피하기 위해 2~3초마다 camera angle이 바뀌도록 요구한다.

“we clearly see every step”를 추가하고, 정확한 micro-actions(crack/spin/chop, launch/land)을 나열해 동작의 가독성을 높이고 모호한 움직임을 줄인다.

일관된 visual style stack(cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain)을 정의하고, 원치 않는 스타일화의 드리프트를 막기 위해 부정적 스타일 제약(not cartoon/Disney/Pixar)을 포함한다.

반복되는 제약(warm dramatic lighting, constant steam rising, sizzling sound constant)으로 지속적인 환경 연속성을 강화해 클립 전체의 분위기를 안정적으로 유지한다.

모델이 단계를 재배열하거나 앞서 나가지 않도록 “chronological cooking order maintained throughout”를 포함한다.
---

pt.content:
Estruture um prompt de 15s para Seedance com timecodes explícitos (por exemplo, 0:00–0:02, 0:02–0:04) para forçar uma sequência clara de ações, batida por batida.

Use uma character sheet enviada e inclua “strict visual reference” junto com roupas/acessórios detalhados para manter a identidade do personagem consistente entre os planos.

Especifique explicitamente o comportamento do áudio (a trilha começa no primeiro frame, nunca para, SFX de fundo constantes, ações sincronizadas com a batida) para travar o timing e a continuidade sonora.

Indique os tipos de plano por batida (wide/close/overhead) e exija mudanças de ângulo de câmera a cada 2–3 segundos para evitar enquadramento estático.

Adicione “we clearly see every step” e liste as microações exatas (crack/spin/chop, launch/land) para melhorar a legibilidade da ação e reduzir movimentos ambíguos.

Defina uma stack consistente de estilo visual (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain) e inclua restrições negativas de estilo (not cartoon/Disney/Pixar) para evitar deriva de estilização indesejada.

Reforce a continuidade ambiental persistente com restrições repetidas (warm dramatic lighting, constant steam rising, sizzling sound constant) para manter a atmosfera estável ao longo do clipe.

Inclua “chronological cooking order maintained throughout” para impedir que o modelo reordene as etapas ou avance para frente.

zh.content:
构建一个 15 秒的 Seedance prompt，并使用明确的时间码（例如 0:00–0:02、0:02–0:04），以强制形成清晰的逐拍动作序列。

使用上传的角色设定图，并写明“strict visual reference”，再配合详细的服装/道具描述，以确保角色身份在不同镜头中保持一致。

明确指定音频行为（音轨从第 1 帧开始，永不停止，持续的底层 SFX，动作与节拍同步），以锁定时间节奏和声音连续性。

按每个节拍标注镜头类型（wide/close/overhead），并要求每 2–3 秒改变一次 camera angle，以避免静态构图。

加入“we clearly see every step”，并列出精确的微动作（crack/spin/chop、launch/land），以提升动作可读性并减少含糊的运动表现。

定义一致的视觉风格组合（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime、semi-realistic CGI、hand-painted textures、Unreal Engine quality、film grain），并加入负面风格约束（not cartoon/Disney/Pixar），以防止不想要的风格漂移。

通过重复约束强化持续的环境连贯性（warm dramatic lighting、constant steam rising、sizzling sound constant），以保持整段视频的氛围稳定。

加入“chronological cooking order maintained throughout”，以防模型重新排序步骤或提前跳步。
